description:
A JOB OPPORTUNITY AT

GOPA Pro GmbH

A JOB THAT INSPIRES YOU

As our Digital Solutions Manager, you will design, develop, test, implement and maintain business-oriented solutions, with a particular focus on automation in the Microsoft 365 environment, including SharePoint, Microsoft Lists, Teams, Power Apps, Power Automate and related tools. You will work with internal colleagues to identify and prioritise digitalisation and automation initiatives and ensure that solutions are secure, documented and user friendly. You will also explore AI use cases where there is clear business benefit. 
 
This is a great learning opportunity for a junior digital professional looking for a role with real impact, real learning opportunities, and supported autonomy. 

Your tasks will include:
 
  • Work with colleagues to design, develop, test, and maintain digital business solutions and workflow automations in the Microsoft 365 environment 
  • Develop automations that improve efficiency, transparency, and data quality. 
  • Prepare user documentation, guidance, and training materials. 
  • Document lessons learned, best practices, and reusable components from solution development. 
  • Contribute to the development of a digital solutions knowledge base and community of practice.

A BACKGROUND THAT CONVINCES US

Your profile:
 
  • Relevant experience in workflow automation, digital solution delivery or comparable work, preferably in a Microsoft 365 environment. Experience gained during internships or educational coursework is accepted.
  • Practical experience with Microsoft Power Platform, particularly Power Automate and Power Apps, is an advantage. 
  • Good practical experience with SharePoint Online, Microsoft Lists, Teams and Microsoft 365 integration. 
  • Basic understanding of AI-supported productivity tools, Microsoft Copilot or comparable AI applications is an advantage. 
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a hands-on, service-oriented working style. 
  • Ability to communicate technical topics clearly to non-technical colleagues and management. 
  • Very good command of English; German or another relevant working language is an advantage.

AN ENVIRONMENT THAT MOTIVATES YOU


  • Team & culture: You will join dynamic, multi-cultural and multilingual team members who enjoy working together and who support each other.
  • Responsibility: You join a company committed to being environmentally responsible wherever we operate.
  • Development: Our annual career development and performance review process will help you to set clearly defined goals and objectives. As a new employee, you will be part of a mentorship system.
  • Location: GOPA is headquartered in Bad Homburg, enabling quick and easy access to Frankfurt’s cultural activities and events, but also has international locations in Belgium, Romania, Turkey, North Macedonia and more
  • Flexibility: We enable flexible work arrangements, including flexible working hours, mobile or telework.

READY FOR CHANGE?

We are looking forward to receiving your online application, including your possible start date and salary expectation.
